title: LR2Bench: Evaluating Long-chain Reflective Reasoning Capabilities of Large Language Models via Constraint Satisfaction Problems
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the reflective reasoning capabilities of LLMs through logical puzzles like Sudoku and Crosswords. While some Crossword or Acrostic clues may mention religious terms (e.g., 'Christianity', 'grace') or moral aphorisms as general knowledge points, the paper does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, ethics, or moral systems as its subject matter.
